summary: The request did not specify a message identifier for the selected operation.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: message identifier is not specified

possible_causes: The inline-message path was selected without a nonempty inline_message_id.
diagnostic_limits: This signature does not diagnose all missing message_id arguments; a chat-based lookup may return an operation-specific not-found error.

evidence.note: The inline-message identifier helper rejects an empty argument.
Editing takes this path when chat_id is empty and the parsed message_id is zero.
Method validation errors are passed to the response normalizer.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: message identifier is not specified

preconditions: Supply the intended inline_message_id or the appropriate chat_id and message_id pair.
